Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-polish-medium-0028", "row_sha256": "c3704c1c8207bc41e45e87e4efef53bafd765139434eee3723d4b19868e4c23d", "mode": "/polish", "language": "en", "context": {"profile": "Plain and direct."}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Rewrite awkward phrasing into readable prose for the supplied profile, or plain prose when none is supplied. Preserve intent and certainty. Do not add a greeting, subject, signature, conclusion, or fact that the input did not supply.", "input": "i coordinate the lending shelf at the community center, which is open on tuesdays and thursdays. borrowers write their name and the return date on a card inside each game box. last thursday, ben returned ticket to ride and told me the red train token was missing when he opened the box at home. he said he had checked his bag before bringing it back, but he wasn't sure whether the token had been missing earlier. i put a note on the game's card so the next borrower would see it.

I asked Nia to look in the storage cupboard and bring a spare red token to the shelf before saturday's family afternoon. She hasn't said whether she can do that yet. Dara suggested that we move the games for younger children to the lower shelf, because several children couldn't reach them during the last event. the lower shelf has space for about six boxes, and we currently have nine games marked for ages six and under. I recorded Dara's suggestion in the volunteer notebook, but we haven't changed the arrangement. The sign beside the shelf also needs updating: it still says returns are due on Wednesdays, even though we changed the return day to Thursday in April. I can replace the sign when I am next at the center, provided the printer is available.", "output": "I coordinate the community center's lending shelf, which is open on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Borrowers write their names and return dates on a card inside each game box. Last Thursday, Ben returned Ticket to Ride and told me that the red train token was missing when he opened the box at home. He said he had checked his bag before returning the game, but he wasn't sure whether the token had been missing earlier. I added a note to the game's card so the next borrower would see it.

I asked Nia to check the storage cupboard and bring a spare red token to the shelf before Saturday's family afternoon. She hasn't said whether she can do that yet. Dara suggested moving the games for younger children to the lower shelf because several children couldn't reach them during the last event. The lower shelf has room for about six boxes, and we currently have nine games marked for ages six and under. I recorded Dara's suggestion in the volunteer notebook, but we haven't changed the arrangement. The sign beside the shelf also needs updating: it still says returns are due on Wednesdays, although we changed the return day to Thursday in April. I can replace the sign the next time I'm at the center, provided the printer is available."}]
